about_item: 🐶Supportive Design: JOEJOY Rectangle Dog Bed is specifically designed to provide excellent support and comfort for your furry friend. With raised four walls and a pillow-like structure, it offers excellent support and cushioning for their head and neck while reducing exposure to drafts. The low leading-edge design also ensures easy access for your pet. Your buddies will love the feel of the comfortable sleeping area.

🐶Luxury and Soft Material: Our Pet bed is covered in rose swirl short faux fur and cozy suede fabric, providing the ultimate luxury and softness. It is perfect for keeping your pet warm and comfortable during the winter, effectively retaining their body heat. The bottom and sides are filled with thick, high-resilience polyester fiber, creating a breathable and comfortable sleeping environment that keeps your dog off the floor, ensuring elevated comfort for your pet while snoozing.

🐶Multiple Size Options: We offer a range of sizes to cater to dogs of different breeds and sizes. Whether you have a small, medium, or large dog, our dog bed has the perfect size for them. For medium dogs, the outer size is 30"x24"x9", and the inner size is 22"x17". Please review the measurements to ensure the correct fit for your pet. If you're unsure, we recommend choosing one size up for extra comfort.

🐶Non-Slip and Durable: Our dog bed features a non-slip bottom, ensuring that it stays in place on tile and hardwood floors. The durable construction of the bed maintains its shape like a rectangular sofa, providing long-lasting support for your pet. The puppy bed can be used on the ground, in a crate, on a sofa, or even in the backseat of a car. With its neutral and cozy color, it can easily match any furniture and any space.

🐶 Easy to Clean: We understand that accidents happen, which is why our dog bed is designed to be easy to clean. It is completely machine washable, although we recommend hand washing for best results. After washing, make sure to thoroughly dry the bed in the dryer on low heat; avoid air drying.

authors_reviews.title: He’s so funny but seriously - measure first
authors_reviews.text: Tip: Measure your pet first from tip of noise to the start of the tail to be sure the bed is long enough for your pet friend to stretch fully.The bed arrives flat and fluffs up like a pillow. The dog bed I received took about 3 days to gain full size.There was a small amount of “new” smell to it. The cats liked the pet bed first. The dogs rotate sleeping in the bed.I purchased the bed for a dachshund mix who had back surgery about a month ago for a spinal disc that slipped completely out of the spine rut to an unfortunate acccident.He has made an almost complete ❤️‍🩹 recovery for which I am thankful to God because the alternative was euthanizing.At the beginning he had lost the ability to urinate independently and needed a Foley catheter and had no bowel control.You can understand that I needed a comfortable bed that was also a hospital bed. Yes there are other options on Amazon and between Amazon and pet stores, I’ve tried many.This review is for you all out there who are wondering of this is the best purchase for the money.I have purchased different pet beds for cats and dogs for many years. Usually they sleep on a blanket that they move and create a nest for their individual needs. Yeah, they are spoiled.Blankets are easier to wash.Pet beds are a waste of money even the ones that have zippers.This pet bed has zero zippers. I knew this would be a disposable pet bed. I always prefer beds with zippers to avoid filling a landfill.In this case, I wanted the bed to be comfortable for the dog’s back. He has a very long, but short body.You can see from the video that he likes the bed but struggles to get comfortable because he cannot stretch fully.My plan is to purchase a longer bed. He is unable to curl like he did before the back surgery. The surgery was performed by a visit veterinarian at Sage in Round Rock Texas. This is not an ad. This is a fact. This dog acts as a therapeutic dog for a disabled family member. He is very good at his job. I do not believe he is replaceable. So I invest in him and all my pet friends.I highly recommend considering your pet’s sleeping style. If this dog could curl, this bed would have been perfect for him. He spends most of his days sleeping stretched out on the bare floor because it’s temperature is cool and he can stretch out fully. He often uses this bed as a pillow as he sleeps on the floor. It’s just the right softness and height for his head.As you see from the video, a longer bed would have given him the option to fully stretch his back.The seams in the bed are well construction. None of the pet claws have torn the fabric as they try to create a nest in the bed.A large long haired cat also enjoys the same bed and stretches out fully rolling side to side. I like that the bed does not pull pet hair like tape. I also like that the bed does not hold odor after a rain.Some pet beds are very warm which is great in the Winter but not so great in the summer. This bed seems to be okay until the outside temperature rises into the near 100 degree range. When the inside temperature warms, the dogs reject the bed and use the cooler bare floor.My plan is to purchase a longer vision of this bed.Keep in mind that the dogs did not like this bed for several days and would not use it. One cat used it immediately. So give the bed time to become part of the household smells. My dogs fluffed the bed themselves.My hope is that I’ve given enough information to help you make an informed purchase. If any part was helpful, kindly select helpful which will help others make an informed purchase.It’s difficult to judge a product from a photo and marketing tactics. I hope this review was both entertaining and helpful in your decision making journey.The video shows how my pet friend uses the bolster of the bed as a pillow and how he stretches. Sometimes he puts his weaker leg since the shallow part of the bed opening and the rest of his body stretches onto the floor.One photo shows how he uses the bed as a pillow as he sleeps on the door aligning his spine between two different beds. The other furry bed seems to be too hot in the summer months.The next photo shows a Chihuahua- Bichon mix 23 inches from top of nose to base of tail using the same bed and the booster as a pillow. He’s older and wiser, so he uses the diagonal length of the bed to stretch out fully as he sleeps.Cheers~
